taste:
This is a robust, beef-led meal with a firmer texture than diners seeking a tender steak might expect. The source description emphasises the rump cut’s deep, rich flavour, so its main appeal is the beef itself rather than elaborate accompaniments. Aberdeen Angus beef forms the centre of the plate, and the steak is grilled to your preference. Be clear about your preferred doneness when ordering.

Served sizzling hot with a generous portion of chips, it is aimed squarely at a hearty appetite. Garden peas, a grilled tomato and a flat mushroom complete the plate without distracting from the substantial cut. Choose it if you enjoy a steak with some chew and pronounced beef flavour, rather than expecting a soft texture throughout.
